editorial.title: Who Is Deepak Dhar? The Small-Town UP Boy Who Studied Under Feynman — and Just Joined Physics' Most Exclusive Club
editorial.excerpt: The 74-year-old Indian theoretical physicist just won the 2026 Dirac Medal, becoming the first Indian-born recipient. His journey from Pratapgarh to Caltech to the pinnacle of world physics — and the sandpile that connects it all to AI.
editorial.image_caption: Deepak Dhar, INSA Distinguished Professor at ICTS-TIFR Bengaluru. The 74-year-old theoretical physicist won the 2026 ICTP Dirac Medal for his contributions to statistical mechanics.

sources.label: IIT Kanpur - Prof Deepak Dhar Interview

editorial.nri_angle: Deepak Dhar's journey from a small-town UP childhood to Caltech and back to India, winning honors that place him among Hawking and Witten, represents the deep scientific contributions of Indian-origin minds that often go uncelebrated compared to tech industry success stories.
editorial.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Jainendra Jain Becomes First Indian-Origin Physicist to Win Wolf Prize
just_in.excerpt: The Penn State professor and Rajasthan native received the 2025 Wolf Prize in Physics for his discovery of composite fermions, a breakthrough central to quantum computing research.
just_in.image_caption: Prof. Jainendra K. Jain at the Wolf Prize ceremony in Jerusalem. The Penn State physicist is the first person of Indian origin to receive the Wolf Prize in Physics.
just_in.nri_angle: Jainendra Jain becomes the first Indian-origin scientist to win the Wolf Prize in Physics, drawing a direct line from rural Rajasthan to the pinnacle of global physics recognition.

just_in.excerpt: Kshamatvam 2026, the 6th international conference hosted by SDM College of Ayurveda, will bring together up to 2,000 delegates from multiple countries to explore translational Ayurvedic research on autoimmune diseases.
just_in.image_caption: Traditional Ayurvedic medicinal preparations. The Kshamatvam 2026 conference in Udupi, Karnataka, will focus on Ayurvedic approaches to autoimmune disorders.
just_in.nri_angle: International speakers from Germany, Italy, and Argentina highlight growing global interest in Ayurvedic approaches to autoimmune diseases; the conference invites international delegates at dedicated rates, reflecting Ayurveda's expanding reach beyond India.

just_in.nri_angle: Australia is home to nearly one million people of Indian origin. Expanded Air India service through Delhi offers convenient one-stop connections for NRIs and Indian-Americans traveling between the U.S., India, and Australia for family, business, or education.

immigration.title: Millions of Americans Discover Canadian Citizenship Pathway as Birthright Restrictions Loom
immigration.excerpt: Canada's Bill C-3 eliminated generational cutoffs for citizenship by descent, opening the door for millions of Americans with Canadian ancestry — just as the U.S. debates tightening its own birthright rules.
